# 5GS NAS and SMS over NAS (plan M11). The message tables, the ePCO container
# identifiers and the GSM 7-bit alphabet are generated by tools/nasgen.py from
# spec/nas at configure time.

find_package(Python3 3.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(_tables "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nas_tables.cpp")
execute_process(
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/nasgen.py" "${_tables}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE _rc OUTPUT_VARIABLE _log ERROR_VARIABLE _err)
if(NOT _rc EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NAS tables failed:\n${_log}${_err}")
endif()
file(GLOB _nas_inputs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/spec/nas/24501/*.tsv"
     "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/spec/nas/24008/*.tsv" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/spec/nas/23038/*.tsv")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${_nas_inputs}
             "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/nasgen.py")

add_library(ksim_codec_nas STATIC nas.cpp sms.cpp "${_tables}")
add_library(ksim::codec_nas ALIAS ksim_codec_nas)
target_include_directories(ksim_codec_nas PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_link_libraries(ksim_codec_nas PUBLIC ksim::platform PRIVATE ksim::warnings)
ksim_layer(ksim_codec_nas codec)
